title: KP Variant Sifter (ancestry-specific genetic associations)
bodyHtml:
The Variant Sifter is an in-development module that allows you to explore, filter, and prioritize genetically associated variants, credible sets, and tissue-specific epigenomic annotations across a region, providing decision support for prioritization of variants and genes for further research. All genomic coordinates are in the hg19 (GRCh37) genome build. Click the Research Method tab below for full documentation.

The table at the bottom of the page initially shows all variants in this region that are significantly associated with the phenotype you selected. As you add criteria below the genetic association plot (credible sets and/or epigenomic annotations), the table is filtered to display only variants that answer your criteria.

This version of the Variant Sifter accesses single-ancestry genetic associations. Note that associations may not be available for every ancestry in a given genomic region. Click here to access a version of the Variant Sifter that queries multi-ancestry genetic associations.

The current Variant Sifter is a beta version. (Last update: March 24, 2023)

The Variant Sifter is part of the Knowledge Portal Integrative analysis workflow.
